player_rating_model.eligibility: 5 attributable events, or a goal, assist, save, or goalkeeper goal conceded, or a dismissal
limitations: Original heuristic, not a commercial provider rating or calibrated football model
No off-ball positioning, running distance or unobserved mistakes scored; discipline weights are original heuristics
Goalkeeper goals conceded are contextual debits, not attribution of individual fault
Pressure observations and ordinary received passes earn no direct rating bonus

possession.definition: Live restart/recovery to loss; pass/restart-delivery flights belong to initiating team; shot/clearance/parry flights and loose/dead-ball gaps unassigned
